author: Tibees
description:
I traveled to Bordeaux to join a zero-gravity research flight, and ended up staying on the ground. With the researchers and astronaut Thomas Pesquet, I explore how these flights work and what happens to chemistry when you take away gravity-driven convection.

Thank you to UWA’s International Space Centre for inviting me, the Centre for Future Catalysis team for sharing their research, Novespace and the French Space Agency CNES for access and interviews.

People featured in this video include Danail Obreschkow, Riss Wiese, David Gozzard, Hongqi Sun, Caroline Berg, Thomas Pesquet and myself, Toby Hendy.
